Definition: from G2010; permission, i.e. (by implication) full power:--commission.
BiblicalUsage: epitropḗ means permission, that is full power. It occurs just once, in Acts.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold epitropḗ to its plain sense and let the passage speak for itself.
RelatedEvents: Paul Before Felix, Festus, and Agrippa
